mechanism: Both drugs affect CNS function; mefloquine can cause neuropsychiatric effects and seizures while naloxone antagonizes opioid receptors, potentially complicating neurological assessment and increasing seizure risk in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor closely for neurological symptoms and seizure activity; use naloxone cautiously in patients taking mefloquine, particularly those with pre-existing seizure risk or neuropsychiatric conditions.
